experiment: AML E4 synthetic weekly adaptation after reporting-threshold change
data_scope: fully synthetic account-window data; not bank transaction evidence

model.week0_training: 24 reader backprop epochs + one quann_update narrow_search pass on the same week0 train split
model.quann_arm: quann_update only during weekly updates; no gradients/backprop
model.retrain_arm: backprop on trainable token-point codebook + cloud encoder + class reader, 3 epochs/week on week0 labeled train plus accumulated weekly labeled support
model.threshold_share_semantics: legacy 9.2K-10K band feature remains fixed; 5K evidence wording is computed from synthetic deposit amounts
model.reserved_ood_token: amount_median and amount_p95 in 4.2K-5K share a token reserved before week0 but absent from its training examples
model.unseen_token_initialization: the shared 5K amount-motif token starts at the mean week0 normal point and QUANN search is bounded by normal/10K structuring feature points

operating_point.definition: one-vs-rest score threshold from week0 calibration negatives at empirical 99th percentile; fixed for every arm/week

region_maps.projection: PCA fitted on week0 training CloudEncoderND embeddings; week0 and week4 shown in shared coordinates
region_maps.week4_region_source: class prototypes from week0 train transformed by the week4 QUANN model; 5K edge prototype from labeled week4 support; held-out probes plotted separately

explainability_probes.prototype_space: Euclidean distance in CloudEncoderND output; week0 edge reference is leave-one-out from unseen probes, week4 edge prototype uses labeled week4 support

limitations: All typologies, reporting-rule drift, and explanations are synthetic; this is not evidence of real AML detection performance.
The 1% FPR operating point is an empirical week0 calibration quantile; finite synthetic samples make realized FPR discrete and uncertain.
The 5K edge is a deliberately clean, controlled amount-motif shift with other features matched to normal activity; real typologies may be overlapping, strategic, and label-delayed.
The backprop comparator updates trainable token-point coordinates, cloud encoder, and reader on accumulated labeled support; QUANN point updates and backprop are different update mechanisms.
Prototype maps are descriptive PCA projections, not calibrated decision boundaries or SAR decisions.
